title: Being unramified descends along fpqc coverings (Stacks 02VM)
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and let $\{g_i:S_i\to S\}_{i\in I}$ be an fpqc covering of $S$ [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering]. For $i\in I$ let $f_i:X\times_SS_i\to S_i$ be the base change of $f$ along $g_i$, the second projection of the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product]. If $f_i$ is unramified [def-weil-unramified-morphism] (locally of finite type with diagonal $X\times_SS_i\to(X\times_SS_i)\times_{S_i}(X\times_SS_i)$ an open immersion) for every $i\in I$, then $f$ is unramified.

source.place: Descent, Lemma Tag 02VM (lemma-descending-property-unramified, line 6187: 'The property P(f) = "f is unramified" is fpqc local on the base'), first assertion, the direction 'each base change has the property => f has it' of Definition Tag 02KO (definition-property-morphisms-local, line 5310); its proof: unramified = locally of finite type with diagonal an open immersion (Morphisms, Lemma Tag 02GE), and locally of finite type and open immersion are fpqc local on the base (Lemmas Tag 02KX, 02L3)

proof.text: Generate Sieve.ofArrows S' g from the fpqc precover using Precoverage.generate_mem_toGrothendieck. This gives a covering sieve of Scheme.fpqcTopology. Use the canonical IsPullback.of_hasPullback f (g i) squares in the covering-family descent theorem.

Apply Scheme.of_isPullback_of_ofArrows_mem_fpqcTopology with P = LocallyOfFiniteType and the hypotheses (h i).1. Mathlib supplies Zariski locality, base-change stability, and descent along Surjective inf Flat inf QuasiCompact. This proves LocallyOfFiniteType f directly without the sorry-bearing Sheaf local-finite-type descent module.

For each i the open diagonal (h i).2 gives FormallyUnramified (pullback.snd f (g i)) by the Mathlib instance recorded in lem-weil-pbc-unramified-formally-unramified. Apply the same covering-family descent theorem with P = FormallyUnramified. Its locality, base-change stability, and single-morphism descent instances are proved in Mathlib. This proves FormallyUnramified f.

Use FormallyUnramified.isOpenImmersion_diagonal with the descended LocallyOfFiniteType f and FormallyUnramified f to obtain IsOpenImmersion (pullback.diagonal f). Pair this with LocallyOfFiniteType f. The conclusion is the original conjunction, with no statement change.
